repos.description: A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个全面的自托管开源软件目录，涵盖通信、存储、管理、媒体等数十个类别，提供替代SaaS的私有化部署方案。核心价值在于帮助用户实现数据主权、隐私保护和基础设施自主可控。项目持续维护，包含死链检查和活跃度监控，是自建服务器的终极参考指南。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive directory of self-hostable open-source network services and web applications spanning communications, storage, management, media, and dozens of categories. It enables private deployment alternatives to SaaS, empowering data sovereignty, privacy protection, and infrastructure autonomy. Continuously maintained with automated dead link validation and project health monitoring, it serves as the definitive reference for building and maintaining a self-hosted server ecosystem.

repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI是功能完备的自托管AI平台，无缝集成Ollama与OpenAI API，支持完全离线部署。内置RAG推理引擎和原生Python函数调用工具，提供细粒度用户权限管理、响应式界面及PWA移动应用。支持语音/视频通话、Markdown/LaTeX渲染，可通过插件系统扩展功能。提供Docker/Kubernetes部署方案，适用于企业级AI应用开发与私有化大模型部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a comprehensive self-hosted AI platform that seamlessly integrates Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs with full offline deployment capability. Featuring a built-in RAG inference engine and native Python function calling tools, it offers granular user permissions, responsive design, and PWA mobile support. The platform enables voice/video calls, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, and extensible plugin architecture. Deployable via Docker/Kubernetes, it serves as an enterprise-grade solution for private LLM orchestration and AI application development requiring air-gapped security.

repos.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是 HKUDS 开发的开源超轻量级 AI 智能体，核心设计精简且可读。它支持聊天通道、记忆管理和 MCP 协议，可无缝集成工具与工作流。内置 WebUI，提供跨轮次目标追踪和图像生成能力，支持多模型 fallback。从本地快速部署到长期运行的个性化智能体，适用于自动化任务和智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an open-source, ultra-lightweight AI agent developed by HKUDS, featuring a minimalist and readable core design. It supports chat channels, memory management, and the MCP protocol for seamless tool and workflow integration. With a built-in WebUI, it offers cross-turn goal tracking and end-to-end image generation, along with multi-model fallback support. Designed for easy deployment from local setups to long-running personal agents, it is ideal for automation tasks and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw是自主可控的个人AI助手，支持本地或云端部署确保数据隐私。提供日程管理、PDF/Office文档处理、新闻摘要等内置技能，支持自定义扩展。具备多智能体协作能力，可创建独立代理处理不同任务。跨平台连接多种聊天应用，技能决定功能边界，无供应商锁定风险。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant under your control, deployable locally or in the cloud to ensure data privacy. It features built-in skills including scheduling, PDF/Office document processing, and news digests, with support for custom extensions. Enables multi-agent collaboration by creating independent agents for different tasks. Connects across multiple chat platforms with extensible capabilities and no vendor lock-in.

repos.description: The most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library
repos.summary_zh: FingerprintJS是最先进的免费开源浏览器指纹识别库，通过客户端查询浏览器属性计算哈希访客标识符。与Cookie不同，它在隐身模式和清除数据后仍保持一致。适用于访客识别、欺诈检测和Web分析等场景。技术亮点包括npm/CDN简单安装、MIT许可、高兼容性和React支持。提供演示展示持久性，但准确性低于商业版且易被欺骗。
repos.summary_en: FingerprintJS is the most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library. It generates a unique hashed visitor identifier by querying browser attributes on the client-side. Unlike cookies, the fingerprint remains consistent in incognito mode and after clearing browser data. It is ideal for visitor identification, fraud detection, and analytics in web applications. Key highlights include easy installation via npm or CDN, MIT license, high compatibility, and React support. A demo is available to showcase its persistence. However, it has lower accuracy than commercial versions and is vulnerable to spoofing.

repos.description: Open-source gym & body-weight tracker, now in the App Store (iPhone + Apple Watch) and as an Android APK. Plan routines, log workouts, see which muscles are trained, import from Strong/Hevy/FitNotes. Self-host it or use it on the phone alone.
repos.summary_zh: openGym 是一款自托管健身与体重追踪应用，支持训练计划、组数记录、肌肉疲劳分析、跨设备同步与 Passkey 登录。数据完全由用户掌控，支持从 FitNotes/Strong/Hevy 导入，提供 Android APK 与 Web 端，是隐私优先的开源健身管理方案。
repos.summary_en: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker that lets you plan weekly routines, log every set including supersets, warm-ups, and cardio, and visualize which muscles are trained, fatigued, or detrained. It supports cross-device sync, passkey login, and data import from FitNotes, Strong, and Hevy. Your data stays on your own server, giving you full ownership and privacy. Available as a web app and Android APK, it's a privacy-first, open-source alternative to commercial fitness subscriptions, with stats dashboards featuring heatmaps, charts, and personal records.

repos.description: The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC 🦬
repos.summary_zh: Yaak 是一款隐私优先的跨平台桌面 API 客户端，全面支持 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket、SSE 和 gRPC 协议。基于 Tauri 框架构建，后端采用 Rust 实现高性能与安全性，前端使用 React 提供流畅交互。通过社区许可模式运营，为开发者提供直观、高效的 API 调试与管理解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Yaak is a privacy-first cross-platform desktop API client supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, and gRPC protocols. Built on Tauri framework with Rust backend and React frontend, it delivers high-performance API debugging experience. Community-funded through license purchases, it offers intuitive interface for developers to organize, test, and manage APIs efficiently.

repos.description: Admin Dashboard UI built with Shadcn and Vite.
repos.summary_zh: satnaing/shadcn-admin 是基于 Shadcn UI 和 Vite 构建的企业级管理后台 UI 组件库。提供 10+ 预置页面、响应式布局、亮暗主题切换及完善的 RTL 语言支持，深度优化可访问性。通过自定义 Shadcn 组件与 TanStack Router 集成，为开发者提供可直接复用的生产级界面解决方案，显著加速后台系统开发。
repos.summary_en: satnaing/shadcn-admin is a production-grade admin dashboard UI library built with Shadcn UI and Vite. It features 10+ pre-built pages, responsive layouts, light/dark themes, comprehensive RTL support, and deep accessibility optimization. By customizing Shadcn components and integrating TanStack Router, it delivers reusable, enterprise-ready UI solutions that dramatically accelerate backend development.

repos.description: Gradio WebUI for creators and developers, featuring key TTS (Edge-TTS, kokoro) and zero-shot Voice Cloning (E2 & F5-TTS, CosyVoice), with Whisper audio processing, YouTube download, Demucs vocal isolation, and multilingual translation.
repos.summary_zh: Voice-Pro是集YouTube视频下载、人声分离、语音识别、多语言翻译与TTS于一体的AI音频创作平台。基于Gradio构建，集成Whisper、F5-TTS、CosyVoice等前沿模型，支持零样本语音克隆与高质量配音，为创作者提供一站式多语言内容本地化解决方案，显著提升跨语言内容生产效率。
repos.summary_en: Voice-Pro is an all-in-one AI audio creation platform that seamlessly integrates YouTube video downloading, vocal isolation, speech recognition, multilingual translation and text-to-speech capabilities. Built on Gradio with cutting-edge models including Whisper, F5-TTS, E2-TTS and CosyVoice, it enables zero-shot voice cloning and professional-grade dubbing. The platform provides creators and developers with a comprehensive solution for multilingual content localization, significantly enhancing cross-lingual content production efficiency.

repos.description: High-performance browser automation bridge and multi-instance orchestrator with advanced stealth injection and real-time dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: PinchTab 是专为 AI 智能体设计的高性能浏览器自动化桥接器。通过 12MB 的 Go 二进制文件提供 HTTP API，支持多实例 Chrome 进程 orchestration 与隐身注入。核心突破在于 token 效率——文本提取仅需 800 tokens/页，成本比截图方案低 5-13 倍。具备持久化配置文件、ARM64 优化和实时仪表板，是 AI 驱动 Web 自动化的轻量级基础设施。
repos.summary_en: PinchTab is a high-performance browser automation bridge designed for AI agents. This 12MB Go binary delivers HTTP API for multi-instance Chrome orchestration with advanced stealth injection. Its breakthrough is token efficiency—text extraction costs only 800 tokens/page, 5-13x cheaper than screenshots. Featuring persistent profiles, ARM64 optimization, and real-time dashboard, it's the lightweight infrastructure for AI-driven web automation.

repos.description: 🏋 Modern open-source fitness coaching platform. Create workout plans, track progress, and access a comprehensive exercise database.
repos.summary_zh: Workout.cool 是一个现代开源健身教练平台，支持创建个性化训练计划、追踪健身进度，并提供包含详细说明与视频演示的全面运动数据库。基于 Next.js 16、Prisma ORM 和 Feature-Sliced Design 架构构建，具备 Docker 自托管、多语言支持及 Stripe 集成，旨在为健身开源社区提供可靠、可维护的自托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Workout.cool is a modern open-source fitness coaching platform for creating personalized workout plans, tracking progress, and accessing a comprehensive exercise database with detailed instructions and video demos. Built on Next.js 16, Prisma ORM, and Feature-Sliced Design architecture, it supports Docker self-hosting, i18n, and Stripe integration, reviving reliable tools for the fitness open-source community.

repos.description: OpenClaw: Use All Major AI Models NO API Token! Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao/Grok/Qwen/Manus/Kimi
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Zero Token 是 OpenClaw 的零 Token 分支，通过浏览器驱动官方网页 UI（Playwright CDP 自动化）实现无需 API Token 免费调用 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao、Kimi 等十余款主流大模型。提供统一 HTTP 网关、Web UI、CLI/TUI 接口，支持提示注入工具调用（web_search 等）和 AskOnce 多模型对比。本地存储凭证，无配额限制。适用于 AI 开发者构建智能体、模型测试及成本敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw Zero Token is a fork of OpenClaw focused on zero-token LLM access. It automates official web UIs via browser login (Playwright CDP) to freely call Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Kimi and more through a unified gateway. Features include prompt-injected tool calling, AskOnce multi-model comparison, Web UI, CLI, and local credential storage. No API keys or quotas required. Ideal for developers building AI agents, model benchmarking, and cost-free LLM workflows on Node.js with Chrome.

repos.description: Terraink: The Cartographic Poster Engine that creates unique and customizable map posters
repos.summary_zh: TerraInk 是一款基于 OpenStreetMap 数据的地图海报生成引擎。用户可通过地理编码搜索全球任意地点，自定义配色主题、地图图层和字体样式，并导出高分辨率 PNG 打印文件。采用 Bun+React+TypeScript 全栈技术，集成 MapLibre 实现矢量地图渲染，为设计师和地理爱好者提供便捷的创意地图制作工具。
repos.summary_en: TerraInk is a cartographic poster engine that generates unique, customizable map posters using real OpenStreetMap data. The platform offers smart geocoding for global locations, a rich theme system with dozens of curated color palettes, detailed map layer controls for roads, water, parks and buildings, and flexible typography options with Google Fonts integration. Built on a modern Bun+React+TypeScript stack with MapLibre for vector tile rendering, it enables users to export print-ready high-resolution PNG posters at any dimension, serving as an accessible creative tool for designers, geography enthusiasts, and anyone seeking personalized map art.

repos.description: A browser extension that helps users publish content to multiple social media platforms with one click.
repos.summary_zh: 这款浏览器扩展MultiPost支持一键将内容同步发布到知乎、微博、小红书、抖音等10多个平台。无需任何登录或API Key，完全免费。提供扩展API和RESTful API便于开发者集成。解决了内容创作者跨平台发布的难题，提升效率。适用于社交媒体营销和内容自动化分发场景。
repos.summary_en: MultiPost is a browser extension that allows users to publish content such as text, images, and videos to over 10 social media platforms including Zhihu, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin with just one click. No login, registration, or API key is needed, and the service is completely free. It provides an Extension API and a RESTful API for easy integration into web applications or scripts. This tool solves the challenges content creators face when posting across multiple platforms, greatly improving efficiency. It is ideal for social media marketing and automated content distribution scenarios, with a companion Markdown editor available.

repos.description: Modern Admin Dashboard Template built with Shadcn UI and Next.js 16
repos.summary_zh: 基于Next.js 16、TypeScript与Shadcn UI的现代化管理后台模板，提供CRM、财务等多场景仪表板。支持亮暗主题切换、响应式布局与同构文件系统架构，内置Tailwind CSS v4、Zustand状态管理和TanStack Table数据处理，助力快速构建可扩展的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: Modern admin dashboard template built with Next.js 16, TypeScript and Shadcn UI, featuring multiple pre-built dashboards for CRM, finance and other business scenarios. Supports light/dark theme switching with multiple color presets, responsive layouts, and colocation-based file system architecture for better code organization. Integrated with Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand for lightweight state management, and TanStack Table for advanced data handling. Includes authentication flows and role-based access control (planned). Enables rapid development of scalable enterprise applications with customizable themes and flexible layouts.

repos.description: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
repos.summary_zh: RAG Web UI是基于RAG技术的智能对话系统，用于构建私有化知识库问答服务。支持PDF、DOCX、Markdown等文档的自动分块与向量化，兼容OpenAI、DeepSeek及Ollama本地模型，可切换ChromaDB/Qdrant向量数据库。具备多轮对话、引用溯源、异步处理及OpenAPI接口，适用于企业知识库与智能客服场景。
repos.summary_en: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology for building private knowledge base Q&A services. It offers comprehensive document management supporting PDF, DOCX, Markdown formats with automatic chunking and vectorization. The system features a frontend-backend separated architecture, flexible LLM support (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), and interchangeable vector databases (ChromaDB, Qdrant) via Factory pattern. Production-ready capabilities include multi-turn dialogue, citation tracking, async processing, and OpenAPI interfaces, suitable for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent customer service applications.

repos.description: An open source fingerprint browser based on Ungoogled Chromium. 指纹浏览器 隐私浏览器
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于Ungoogled Chromium开源项目的隐私浏览器，专门设计用于对抗浏览器指纹追踪。项目提供Chromium 138至144多个版本的预编译二进制文件，全面支持Windows、Linux和macOS平台。通过深度移除Google服务组件并强化反指纹采集机制，有效保护用户隐私，适用于需要高匿名性的网络访问和多账号管理场景。
repos.summary_en: This is an open-source privacy browser based on Ungoogled Chromium, specifically engineered to resist browser fingerprinting. The project offers pre-compiled binaries for Chromium versions 138 through 144, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. By deeply removing Google services and enhancing anti-fingerprinting protections, it effectively prevents fingerprint collection while maintaining Chromium's core functionality. Perfect for anonymous browsing and multi-account management requiring strong privacy controls.

repos.description: 🏆 Top-1 on 5+ benchmarks | Web UI | Supports MiroThinker, Claude, Kimi, OpenAI
repos.summary_zh: MiroFlow 是一款性能优先的开源 AI 智能体框架，在 9+ 基准测试中提升任意大模型性能。支持 GPT-5、Claude、Kimi 等模型一键切换，通过智能回滚、迭代推理和工具编排优化表现。提供 FastAPI+React Web 界面、无代码技能系统和多智能体图工作流，适用于模型评估、智能体研发与生产部署，结果完全可复现。
repos.summary_en: MiroFlow is a performance-first open-source AI agent framework that enhances any LLM's capabilities across 9+ benchmarks. It enables one-line model switching between GPT-5, Claude, Kimi, and others via YAML config, optimizing performance through smart rollback, iterative reasoning, and tool orchestration. Features include a FastAPI+React Web UI, code-free skill system, and multi-agent graph workflows, ideal for model evaluation, agent development, and production deployment with fully reproducible results.

repos.description: Free, open-source web app for learning about ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies, design your own visually, export as RDF/XML, and share interactive diagrams. Zero backend, fully static.
repos.summary_zh: Ontology Playground是一款免费开源的纯静态网页应用，专为学习本体论及Microsoft Fabric IQ语义建模设计。用户可浏览零售、医疗等六大领域预构建本体目录，使用可视化编辑器设计本体并实时预览Cytoscape.js交互图表，支持RDF/XML导入导出与GitHub一键PR提交。内置结构化学习课程、实验室、任务系统及嵌入式组件，采用React 19和TypeScript构建，无后端依赖。适用于数据工程师与AI开发者快速掌握企业知识图谱构建技能。
repos.summary_en: Ontology Playground is a free, open-source, fully static web app for learning ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ semantic modeling. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies across six domains like Retail and Healthcare, visually design with live Cytoscape.js graph previews, import/export RDF/XML, and submit PRs via GitHub. Features a learning hub with courses, labs, quests, and embeddable widgets. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, zero backend. Ideal for data professionals and AI developers mastering enterprise knowledge graphs.

repos.description: A high-performance ASCII video rendering engine featuring real-time WebSocket binary streaming and an isolated compiler for serverless static generation. Built for low-latency 30 FPS playback on HTML5 Canvas.
repos.summary_zh: ASCILINE是一款高性能跨平台实时ASCII视频渲染引擎，通过WebSocket二进制帧流传输至HTML5 Canvas，实现超低延迟30FPS播放。核心价值在于将视频像素映射为纯文本画布，支持实时CSS滤镜、低带宽零GPU运行及轻量LLM的AI语义处理。采用Python/FastAPI后端结合OpenCV和NumPy解码映射，支持多色彩模式、自适应编解码、音频同步、播放列表及YouTube/摄像头流。适用于低资源设备、交互式网页媒体交付和嵌入式场景，无需传统视频标签。
repos.summary_en: ASCILINE is a high-performance, cross-platform real-time ASCII video rendering engine that streams binary-encoded frames via WebSockets to HTML5 Canvas for ultra-low latency 30 FPS playback. It transforms video into pure typographic canvas content, enabling real-time CSS filters, low-bandwidth zero-GPU operation on constrained devices, and seamless integration with lightweight LLMs for AI processing. Python/FastAPI backend uses OpenCV and NumPy for decoding and mapping; vanilla JS frontend handles rendering. Supports multiple color modes, adaptive codecs, audio sync, playlists, YouTube, and webcam streaming. Ideal for interactive web media, embedded systems, and low-resource environments without video elements.

repos.description: 专为已有 Giffgaff 和 Simyo 号码的用户设计的现代化 eSIM 管理工具集，支持将物理 SIM 卡转换为 eSIM、设备更换和二维码生成。(A modern set of eSIM management tools designed specifically for users who already have Giffgaff and Simyo numbers, offering support for converting physical SIM cards to eSIMs, device replacements, and QR code generation.)
repos.summary_zh: eSIM Tools 为 Giffgaff 和 Simyo 用户提供在线 eSIM 管理服务。支持物理 SIM 转 eSIM、设备更换和二维码生成，全自动化 1-2 分钟完成。数据本地处理保障隐私，支持 PWA 离线使用。技术亮点为原生 JS、OAuth 认证和跨平台访问。
repos.summary_en: eSIM Tools is a modern online eSIM management toolset designed for existing Giffgaff and Simyo users. It supports converting physical SIMs to eSIMs, device replacements, and QR code generation through fully automated processes that take only 1-2 minutes without customer support. All data is processed locally in the browser for privacy, with PWA support for offline use. Built with native JavaScript and no frameworks, it features OAuth 2.0 PKCE, SMS verification, and GraphQL integration. The tool is ideal for users switching devices or migrating to eSIM on compatible iOS and Android phones.

repos.description: AI deep-research agent that turns any question into a cited report: plans searches, reads real sources, verifies evidence. Self-hosted, multi-provider, Docker-ready.
repos.summary_zh: 基于深度研究的AI助手，通过迭代搜索与LLM实现自动化信息挖掘。支持DeepSeek R1等主流模型，提供树状可视化研究流程与实时流式反馈。采用浏览器本地化处理确保数据安全，集成Tavily/Firecrawl多源搜索。支持PDF导出与Docker部署，适用于学术研究、市场分析等深度调研场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered research assistant that automates deep information gathering through iterative search and LLM reasoning. Features real-time streaming feedback and tree-structured visualization of research processes. Supports DeepSeek R1 and major LLM providers with local browser processing for data privacy. Integrates Tavily and Firecrawl for web search, offers PDF export, Docker deployment, and server mode. Ideal for academic research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence requiring comprehensive, automated investigation with full citation tracking.

repos.description: codex-console 是一个集成化控制台项目，支持任务管理、批量处理、数据导出、自动上传、日志查看与打包支持。
repos.summary_zh: codex-console 是专为解决 OpenAI 注册链路不稳定性而生的增强版控制台。它修复了 Sentinel POW 验证、拆分注册登录流程、优化验证码处理，支持批量账号管理、Web UI 操作、多邮箱接码及 PostgreSQL。提供跨平台打包与 Docker 部署，是稳定获取 OpenAI Token 的自动化运维利器。
repos.summary_en: codex-console is an enhanced management console designed to address OpenAI registration instability. It fixes Sentinel POW verification, separates registration/login flows, and optimizes email verification handling. Featuring batch account management, Web UI, multi-email support, PostgreSQL, and cross-platform deployment, it's a robust automation tool for stable OpenAI token acquisition.

repos.description: a multi node frp webui and for https://github.com/fatedier/frp server and client management, which makes this project a Cloudflare Tunnel/Tailscale Funnel/Ngork platform and agent open source alternative
repos.summary_zh: FRP-Panel 是 frp 的开源可视化管理平台，提供集中式配置、多节点编排与边缘 Worker 部署能力。项目采用 Master-Server-Client 架构，支持 WireGuard 智能组网与动态调度，可替代 Cloudflare Tunnel 等商业服务，大幅简化 NAT 穿透与内网服务暴露的运维复杂度，实现统一认证与实时监控。
repos.summary_en: FRP-Panel is an open-source visual management platform for frp that provides centralized configuration, multi-node orchestration, and edge Worker deployment capabilities. Adopting a Master-Server-Client architecture, it supports WireGuard smart networking and dynamic scheduling, serving as a self-hosted alternative to commercial services like Cloudflare Tunnel. The platform significantly simplifies NAT traversal and internal service exposure operations while enabling unified authentication, real-time monitoring, and zero-configuration credential distribution across distributed environments.

repos.description: Run OpenClaw AI Gateway on Android — standalone Flutter app with built-in terminal, web dashboard, and one-tap setup. Also available as a Termux CLI package.
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 将 OpenClaw AI 网关移植到 Android 平台，提供免 root 的 Flutter 独立应用和 Termux CLI 两种模式。通过 proot 技术自动构建 Ubuntu 环境并安装 Node.js 22 和 OpenClaw，实现一键部署。应用内置终端模拟器、Web 管理面板、实时日志查看和网关启停控制，支持 API 密钥配置和后台常驻服务。可选安装 Go 和 Homebrew 开发工具，让 Android 设备成为便携的 AI 网关节点。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw brings the OpenClaw AI Gateway to Android via a standalone Flutter app and Termux CLI package. It uses proot to automatically set up an Ubuntu environment with Node.js 22 and OpenClaw, requiring no root access. The app features a built-in terminal emulator, embedded web dashboard, real-time log viewer, and gateway controls. It supports one-tap deployment, API key configuration, background foreground service, and optional installation of Go and Homebrew tools, turning Android devices into portable AI gateway nodes.

repos.description: A golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized by a Grafana dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go实现的SSH tarpit（endlessh），通过故意延迟响应浪费暴力破解攻击者时间，并导出Prometheus指标，配合Grafana仪表板可视化攻击源地理位置与统计数据。适用于SSH安全防护与威胁情报场景，支持Docker部署、GeoIP查询、健康检查，轻量高效且可观测性强。
repos.summary_en: A Golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) that delays responses to waste brute-force attackers' time while exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized via a Grafana dashboard showing geolocations and attack statistics. Ideal for SSH defense and threat intelligence, with Docker support, GeoIP lookup, and health checks.

repos.description: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs
repos.summary_zh: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图艺术生成工具，无需安装即可将全球城市地图转化为精美海报。采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端界面，Rust WASM 处理地图渲染，Bun 作为高性能运行时。支持亚洲、欧洲、美洲等数十个热门城市，提供即时预览与高清导出，是旅行纪念与城市美学创作的理想选择。
repos.summary_en: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map art generator that transforms city maps into stunning posters without installation. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust WASM for map rendering and Bun as the high-performance runtime. Supporting dozens of cities across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, it offers instant preview and HD export, ideal for travel memorabilia and urban aesthetic creation.

repos.description: Secure, production-grade IoT hydroponic automation system with ESP32, MQTT telemetry, and real-time dashboard
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个生产级开源物联网水培自动化系统，基于ESP32硬件和MQTT协议实现pH、EC、温湿度等环境参数实时监测与智能控制。系统采用React+Node.js构建边缘优先的实时仪表板，通过InfluxDB存储时序数据，支持TLS加密通信和RSA签名OTA更新，填补了业余DIY与工业级自动化之间的空白。
repos.summary_en: HydroponicOne is a production-grade open-source IoT automation system for hydroponic farming, built on ESP32 hardware and MQTT telemetry protocol. It enables real-time monitoring and automated control of critical parameters including pH, EC, water level, temperature, and humidity through smart relays for dosing pumps, lights, and ventilation. The system features an edge-first React dashboard with WebSocket communication, enterprise-grade security with TLS encryption and RSA-2048 signed OTA updates, and dual-database architecture (PostgreSQL for config, InfluxDB for time-series data). It bridges the gap between hobbyist DIY setups and expensive industrial automation solutions.

repos.description: 一个透明的 Tavily API 反向代理：将多个 Tavily API Key（额度/credits）汇聚在一个 Master Key 之后，并提供内置 Web UI 用于管理 Key、用量与请求日志。
repos.summary_zh: TavilyProxyManager 是一个专为 Tavily API 设计的高可用代理网关，核心解决多 API Key 的额度聚合与智能调度问题。通过 Master Key 统一鉴权，实现基于剩余额度的动态负载均衡与自动故障切换，有效规避频率限制。内置 Vue3 管理面板提供 Key 管理、用量监控与请求日志分析，同时集成 MCP 协议端点，无缝对接 Claude 等 AI 工具。Go 语言构建，单二进制部署，Docker 开箱即用。
repos.summary_en: TavilyProxyManager is a high-availability proxy gateway designed for Tavily API, solving multi-key quota aggregation and intelligent scheduling. It unifies authentication via Master Key, implements dynamic load balancing based on remaining credits with automatic failover to avoid rate limits. The built-in Vue3 dashboard provides key management, usage monitoring, and request log analysis, while integrated MCP protocol endpoints seamlessly connect with AI tools like Claude. Built with Go, it offers single-binary deployment and Docker-ready out-of-the-box.

repos.description: Two Factor Authentication
repos.summary_zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers的全球加速网络，提供安全便捷的两步验证密钥管理服务。支持TOTP/HOTP自动生成、二维码扫描/图片识别添加、AES-256加密存储，兼容Google Authenticator等多平台导入导出，具备PWA离线使用与WebDAV/S3远程备份能力，适用于个人与企业多设备场景。
repos.summary_en: A secure two-factor authentication (2FA) key management service leveraging Cloudflare Workers for global acceleration. Features include automatic TOTP/HOTP generation, QR code scanning/image recognition for key addition, AES-256 encryption, and seamless import/export from platforms like Google Authenticator. With PWA offline support and remote backup via WebDAV/S3/OneDrive/Google Drive, it provides a unified solution across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

repos.summary_zh: JioFarm是一款Python自动化工具，通过租用印度Jio虚拟号码登录Jio自助服务，自动猎取Google AI Pro/Gemini Pro兑换链接。采用多SMS服务商模块化架构，配备Rich实时仪表盘，发现链接后自动推送Telegram通知。
repos.summary_en: JioFarm is a Python automation tool that rents virtual Jio numbers to hunt Google AI Pro/Gemini Pro redeem links via Jio selfcare. Features modular multi-provider architecture, Rich live dashboard, and Telegram notifications.

repos.description: Automated QwenCloud account registration & API key harvester with multi-threading, TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth
repos.summary_zh: QwenCloud Generator是一款自动化QwenCloud账户注册与API密钥采集工具，支持多线程Playwright浏览器并发操作、TUI实时仪表盘监控、代理轮换及Gmail OAuth邮箱验证。适用于AI开发者批量获取Qwen大模型API访问权限的场景，具备无头模式、自动恢复和页面状态智能检测等亮点，大幅提升注册效率与匿名性。
repos.summary_en: QwenCloud Generator automates QwenCloud account registration and API key harvesting using multi-threaded Playwright browsers, a TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth for verification. Ideal for AI developers needing bulk API access to Qwen models, it supports headless mode via Xvfb, auto-resume, and scenario detection to handle signup flows efficiently and scalably.

repos.description: 华为云 CodeArts Agent OpenAI 兼容代理 · 多账号轮转 + token 自动续期保活 + 并发控制 + WebUI
repos.summary_zh: 华为云 CodeArts Agent（盘古助手）的 OpenAI 兼容代理，纯 Go 实现无需客户端。支持多账号轮转、Token 自动续期保活、并发控制与 WebUI 管理，内置模型可用性探测、每日签到积分自动领取及工具调用支持，可将华为云盘古大模型无缝接入 OpenAI 生态。
repos.summary_en: OpenAI-compatible proxy for Huawei Cloud CodeArts Agent (Pangu). Pure Go, no client required. Features multi-account rotation, auto token refresh, concurrency control, WebUI, model probing, daily credit auto-claim, and tool calling support for seamless integration with the OpenAI ecosystem.
